sources.title: Diprotodon optatum — Australian Museum
sources.supports: Species identity, approximate upper dimensions, large-bellied quadruped, sturdy limbs/small inturned feet and uncertain short-trunk interpretation.
sources.rights: Australian Museum copyrighted text; not embedded.

sources.title: Museums Victoria specimen P12347 — Lake Callabonna Diprotodon
sources.supports: Verified specimen page identifies composite skeleton cast of D.optatum. Whole-body photograph inspected for torso and limbs; not a single-animal scan.
sources.rights: Museums Victoria CC BY4.0 photographs; private reference only.

sources.title: Lake Callabonna Diprotodon whole skeletal mount — John Broomfield
sources.supports: Actual whole-body photo associated with P12347; inspected, showing robust limbs, large chest, elevated shoulder region and small feet.
sources.rights: CC BY4.0, John Broomfield/Museums Victoria. Private reference only, not embedded.

sources.title: AMNH19287 Diprotodon cast skull and shoulder — Bloopityboop
sources.supports: Actually inspected head/shoulder photograph; historical label D.australis retained in provenance, not treated as a separate asset.
sources.rights: CC BY-SA4.0, Bloopityboop; private visual reference only.

sources.title: AMNH19287 Diprotodon skull close view — Bloopityboop
